basic_details.organization_name: National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research Guwahati
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Pharmaceutical Education and Research Guwahati (NIPER Guwahati) has released the official CEO Notification 2026 on its official website, https://niperguwahati.ac.in. A total of 1 vacancy has been announced under the NIPER Guwahati CEO Recruitment 2026. Eligible candidates up to 45 years of age with a Doctorate in Life Sciences or allied sciences with 5 years of experience, or a Master's in Business Management with 10 years of managerial experience, can apply online up to 14-08-2026. The official notification PDF and online application link are available below.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 45 years as on 14-08-2026. Age relaxation for reserved categories as per GoI norms.

qualification.education_qualification: Doctorate in Life Sciences or allied sciences with 5 years experience, Master's in Business Management with 10 years managerial experience
qualification.details: CEO: Doctorate in Life Sciences or allied sciences from a recognized University with at least 05 years experience (excluding Ph.D. tenure) in Industry, CRO, Technology Business Incubators, Start-ups, Innovation Management or Academic/Research organizations OR Master's Degree in Business Management with 10 years managerial experience in at least 2-3 sectors including Industry, CRO, Technology Business Incubators, Start-ups, Venture Capital Firms.

salary_details.details: Consolidated amount of Rs. 1,00,000/- Per Month.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIPER Guwahati CEO Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 14-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIPER Guwahati to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: NIPER Guwahati CEO Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 1 vacancy is available – 1 for the CEO post.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: CEO: Doctorate in Life Sciences or allied sciences from a recognized University with at least 05 years experience (excluding Ph.D. tenure) in Industry, CRO, Technology Business Incubators, Start-ups, Innovation Management or Academic/Research organizations OR Master's Degree in Business Management with 10 years managerial experience in at least 2-3 sectors including Industry, CRO, Technology Business Incubators, Start-ups, Venture Capital Firms.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 45 years as on 14-08-2026. Age relaxation for reserved categories as per GoI norms.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Consolidated amount of Rs. 1,00,000/- Per Month.

content_sections.heading: NIPER Guwahati CEO Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NIPER Guwahati CEO Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 14-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NIPER Guwahati to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIPER Guwahati CEO recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the NIPER Guwahati CEO recruitment is 14th August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the CEO post?
faq.answer: For the CEO post, candidates need a Doctorate in Life Sciences or allied sciences with 5 years of experience, or a Master's in Business Management with 10 years of managerial experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the CEO position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the CEO position is 45 years as of 14th August 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the CEO post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the CEO post will receive a consolidated amount of Rs. 1,00,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the CEO role at NIPER Guwahati?
faq.answer: The selection process for the CEO role includes screening, followed by an interview, and finally document verification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this NIPER Guwahati recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is contractual.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for NIPER Guwahati CEO recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, under the 'Official Notification PDF' link.

faq.question: Q9. How can I apply for the NIPER Guwahati CEO position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website or the provided 'Apply Online' link on or before the last date of application.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is NIPERG/Project-Recrt./2026/05/Re/10.
